notes: Existing Draft 96 and Balanced 128 presets, density 25, no smoothing or fragment removal. No output-quality code was changed.
Single sequential run per preset on a shared desktop, Draft first. Timings are observations, not controlled performance comparisons.
The first Balanced attempt was blocked by the unchanged 3 GB memory guard. The completed Balanced run began after available memory recovered.
Peak process RSS is not peak GPU allocation or total unified-memory pressure. Available GB is sampled at job start, not the minimum during inference.
The reference uses 33 automatic U2Net masks and 1 existing source alpha. These are not human ground truth.
Photo cameras are coarse estimates fitted on the Balanced baseline and frozen for both runs. Symmetric outlines may have ambiguous camera angles.
All 34 valid GLBs being watertight does not imply correct geometry, correct masks, printability, or good reconstruction quality.
